title: How to Track Your ShopKart Order
content:
# How to Track Your ShopKart Order

You can easily check the real-time location and expected delivery schedule of your order:

1. **Via ShopKart App / Website:**
   - Log in to your ShopKart account and click on **'My Orders'**.
   - Select the relevant order and click **'Track Shipment'**.
   - You will see live tracking milestones: *Placed -> Confirmed -> Packed -> Shipped -> In Transit -> Out for Delivery -> Delivered*.

2. **Via Logistics Courier Portal:**
   - Your shipment details include an Air Waybill (AWB) / Tracking Number and Carrier Name (e.g. Delhivery, BlueDart, Ecom Express).
   - You can copy the tracking number and visit the courier's official tracking portal for granular checkpoint updates.

3. **Status Explanations:**
   - **In Transit:** Package is on the move between regional fulfillment sorting centers.
   - **Out for Delivery:** Courier delivery executive has dispatched with your parcel and will attempt delivery today.
   - **Delayed:** Unforeseen transit delays (weather, high volume). New estimated delivery date will be shown.

title: How to Cancel an Order Before Dispatch
content:
# How to Cancel an Order Before Dispatch

If you changed your mind or placed an order by mistake:

### 1. Self-Service Cancellation (Instant)
- Navigate to **'My Orders'** in your ShopKart profile.
- If the order status is **PLACED** or **CONFIRMED**, click the **'Cancel Order'** button.
- Choose your cancellation reason (e.g. *Ordered by mistake, Found cheaper alternative, Expected delivery date too late*) and confirm.

### 2. Can I cancel if the order is Shipped?
- Once an order reaches **PACKED**, **SHIPPED**, or **IN_TRANSIT**, cancellation is locked.
- Do not worry: Simply refuse the package when the courier executive arrives at your doorstep. The item will automatically return to the seller, and your full refund will be processed.

title: Step-by-Step Guide to Request a Return
content:
# Step-by-Step Guide to Request a Return

ShopKart offers hassle-free doorstep returns within the eligible product return window:

1. **Initiating the Request:**
   - Go to **'My Orders'** and select the delivered item.
   - Click **'Request Return / Replace'**.
   - Select the accurate reason: *Damaged, Wrong Product, Defective, Size Issue, Quality Issue, or Not as Expected*.
   - Upload 1–3 clear photos showing the issue, shipping label, and original box.

2. **Doorstep Pickup:**
   - An authorized courier partner will visit your shipping address within 24 to 48 hours.
   - Keep the item along with tags, warranty cards, manuals, and original packaging ready for handover.

3. **Refund or Replacement Trigger:**
   - Once the agent verifies the package condition and marks it 'PICKED_UP', your refund or replacement is initiated automatically.

title: Understanding Refund Timelines and Methods
content:
# Understanding Refund Timelines and Methods

Refunds are processed automatically as soon as an order is cancelled or a returned product is picked up.

### Expected Settlement Time by Payment Mode:
- **UPI (GPay / PhonePe / Paytm / BHIM):** 2 to 24 hours (most credits reflect within 15 minutes).
- **ShopKart Wallet Balance:** Instant (under 10 minutes).
- **Credit / Debit Cards:** 3 to 5 business banking days (subject to issuing bank cycle).
- **Net Banking:** 3 to 7 working days.
- **Cash on Delivery (COD):** 24 to 48 hours after providing verified bank/UPI details.

### If your refund status shows 'PROCESSING':
The transaction has been submitted to the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) or Visa/Mastercard network. Please allow the standard bank clearance window.

title: What to Do When Payment Fails or Money is Deducted
content:
# What to Do When Payment Fails or Money is Deducted

Encountering an issue during checkout can happen due to bank server timeouts or intermittent network drops:

### Scenario 1: Money deducted from bank, but order not created (PAY04)
- This is a temporary gateway drop. The funds are held in the banking clearance pool.
- The payment gateway automatically detects the orphaned transaction and issues an auto-reversal within **24 to 48 banking hours** back to your original source account.

### Scenario 2: Charged twice for a single order (PAY05)
- If your bank account was debited two times for one order, the secondary transaction is automatically identified as a duplicate and refunded within **3 to 5 banking days**.
- If not credited after 5 days, provide the 12-digit Bank RRN / Transaction Reference to ShopKart Support for manual settlement acceleration.

title: What to Do If Your Delivery is Delayed
content:
# What to Do If Your Delivery is Delayed

We aim to deliver every package on or before the estimated delivery date:

1. **Why do delays happen?**
   - Unforeseen severe weather conditions (monsoons, cyclones, waterlogging).
   - High volume festival sales causing sorting hub backlogs.
   - Incomplete customer address or unreachable phone number during delivery attempt.

2. **How to check the revised schedule:**
   - Open **'Track Shipment'** in the app. The revised estimated delivery date and logistics reason will be updated in real time.

3. **Urgent Delivery Escalation:**
   - If your shipment has been stuck at a local hub for more than 48 hours with no movement, our AI assistant or support team can raise an automated priority dispatch ticket with the courier partner.

title: How to Claim Manufacturer Warranty
content:
# How to Claim Manufacturer Warranty

All electronics and brand appliances purchased on ShopKart carry authentic brand manufacturer warranty:

1. **Download Official Proof of Purchase:**
   - Go to **'My Orders'** -> Select the item -> Click **'Download Tax Invoice'**. The GST invoice serves as the primary warranty certificate.

2. **Locating Authorized Service Centers:**
   - Check the product description or warranty card inside the box for the manufacturer's toll-free support helpline or website.
   - For major brands (Apple, Samsung, Dell, Philips, Boat, Sony), walk into any authorized service center with the device and invoice.

3. **Onsite Appliance Servicing:**
   - For TVs, washing machines, and large furniture, call the brand helpline to schedule an authorized technician home visit.

title: Product Replacement and Exchange Process
content:
# Product Replacement and Exchange Process

Need a different size or received a defective unit? Here is how replacement and exchange work:

1. **Requesting Replacement:**
   - Select **'Request Return / Replacement'** on your delivered order page.
   - Select **'Replacement'** if you want the exact same product delivered again due to transit damage or defect.
   - Select **'Size Exchange'** if you need a different apparel or footwear size.

2. **Delivery & Pickup Handover:**
   - In most metro areas, we support **Doorstep Exchange** — the delivery executive brings your new unit and collects the old one during the same visit.

title: Account Recovery and Login Troubleshooting
content:
# Account Recovery and Login Troubleshooting

If you are experiencing issues accessing your ShopKart account:

1. **Forgot Password:**
   - Click **'Forgot Password'** on the login screen.
   - Enter your registered email or mobile number to receive a secure password reset link / OTP.

2. **OTP Not Received:**
   - Ensure you have cellular network coverage and DND settings do not block transactional SMS.
   - Click **'Resend OTP via Call / WhatsApp'** after 30 seconds.

3. **Account Locked or Suspended:**
   - If your account was locked due to multiple failed login attempts or security triggers, submit an identity verification request via registered email to `support@shopkart.in`.

title: Reporting Damaged, Broken or Defective Products
content:
# Reporting Damaged, Broken or Defective Products

If your package arrives physically broken or damaged:

1. **Report Within 48 Hours:**
   - Report the damage immediately from **'My Orders'** -> **'Item Damaged on Arrival'**.
   - Attach clear photographs showing:
     - The outer cardboard box with the shipping courier label visible.
     - The damaged part of the product.

2. **Priority Resolution:**
   - For verified transit damages, ShopKart provides expedited zero-cost replacement dispatch or 100% instant refund upon pickup verification.

title: What to Do If You Received the Wrong Product
content:
# What to Do If You Received the Wrong Product

If you opened your package and discovered an entirely different item, color, or model:

1. **Keep Original Packaging Intact:**
   - Do not discard the box, outer plastic flyer, or courier barcode label.
2. **Submit a Wrong Item Claim:**
   - Go to **'My Orders'** -> Select the order -> Choose reason **'WRONG_PRODUCT'**.
   - Upload photos of the product and barcode tag on the box.
3. **Expedited Swap:**
   - Our logistics partner will pick up the incorrect item and dispatch the correct product right away.

title: What to Do If Order Says Delivered But You Did Not Receive It
content:
# What to Do If Order Says Delivered But You Did Not Receive It

If you receive an SMS or notification stating your order was delivered, but you haven't received the package:

1. **Check with Household & Security:**
   - Often, couriers leave packages with apartment building security guards, reception desks, or neighbors.

2. **Contact Delivery Executive:**
   - The 'Out for Delivery' SMS contains the delivery agent's direct phone number.

3. **Raise a Non-Receipt Dispute (Scenario O08):**
   - If the package is genuinely missing, report the dispute within **24 hours** by clicking **'Didn't Receive Order'** on the order tracking screen.
   - ShopKart opens an immediate geo-location GPS tag audit with the courier service.

title: ShopKart Account Security and Anti-Fraud Guidelines
content:
# ShopKart Account Security and Anti-Fraud Guidelines

Protecting your payment methods and private information is our highest priority:

1. **Never Share OTPs or Passwords:**
   - ShopKart employees and customer support executives will **NEVER** ask for your One-Time Password (OTP), UPI PIN, card CVV, or net banking passwords.

2. **Recognizing Phishing Attempts:**
   - Official communications originate only from `@shopkart.in` and official verified WhatsApp channels.

3. **Reporting Suspicious Activity:**
   - If you notice unauthorized orders placed or profile modifications, immediately select **'Lock Account'** in Security Settings and contact Trust & Safety.
